event.description: Allocate d12 attention with ff33 nonlinear width
event.proposal: family: attention organization; current retained incumbent is 2982 parameters at 99.9700%, a +0.97 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0043, d14/h2 with ff24 at 3038/99.91%; same-family failed result: attempt-0046, one d13 attention head at 2951/1.35% (and the preceding Q/KV tie was 10.29%); prior attempts in this family: 10. Hypothesis: two heads are required, but each d14 head may have excess channel width. Test d12/h2 with a much wider ff33, retaining MQA and independent 6x6 head-local output maps; the candidate is predicted at 2916 parameters. This is more informative than continuing d14 FF interpolation because it shifts capacity from attention channels to nonlinear width while preserving two-head specialization; the nearest untested alternative is d12 with a smaller FF, which would conflate head-width and FF losses before this allocation is measured. Keep two layers, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, learned positions, reversed operands, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2982 parameters.
